name: Call of the Wild
body:
Design invocation (manifestation); Level 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one or more spectral animals, see text
Duration 10 min./level and 1 round/level (D); see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This script functions as call of the hunt, except you manifest more powerful creatures. When you cast this script, choose one of the following animals: dire ape, dire boar, dire wolf, giant wasp, grizzly bear, lion, or young orca (if underwater). You manifest 1d3 of the chosen animal type. Each animal manifested grants a stacking +2 bonus on Survival checks to track.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you manifest another animal of the same type.
